trace.final:
I paid Delta Printworks's approved invoice once, by wire.

- **Invoice:** INV-48187 (Delta Printworks, vendor V-115), due 2026-11-04
- **Amount:** $17,115.57, the full amount
- **Payment ID:** PAY0001, status "sent"
- **Approval:** Payments over $10,000 need controller approval, so this one was sent to an approver first. They approved it ("Approved. Looks right.") before it went out.

Before paying, I checked the payment list and found no earlier payments, so this isn't a duplicate. I also gave the wire a unique ID (`pay-INV-48187`) so it can't be sent twice if the request is repeated.

Delta Printworks has two other invoices, and I didn't touch either one. INV-29792 ($7,973.09) was already paid. INV-83474 ($4,017.27) is still a draft waiting for approval.
